gaps.sentence: The ferry was cancelled; ___, we drove the long way round.
gaps.explanation: 'Consequently' introduces the consequence of the cancellation.

gaps.sentence: He lowered his voice ___ wake the baby.
gaps.explanation: Negative purpose = so as not to / in order not to + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: ___ her age, she still runs marathons.
gaps.explanation: 'In spite of' + noun (her age); the conjunctions would need a clause.

gaps.sentence: I'll take the job ___ they don't offer me any more money.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a future possibility that will not change the decision.

gaps.sentence: He spends money ___ it grew on trees.
gaps.explanation: 'As if it grew on trees' — the unreal comparison justifies the criticism.

gaps.sentence: She has decided to cycle to work ___ taking the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Instead of + -ing' = in place of the bus journey.

gaps.sentence: ___ the north coast is rocky, the southern beaches are soft golden sand.
gaps.explanation: 'While' can contrast two clauses in a single sentence.

gaps.sentence: She speaks fluent Mandarin; ___, she reads classical Chinese.
gaps.explanation: 'Moreover' adds a further, even more remarkable achievement.
